$comment: MCP server registration. Runs bin/claude-workspaces-mcp.sh under /bin/sh, which resolves a node binary itself and execs the bundled mcp/index.js. It does NOT say `command: node`: node is often installed by nvm, whose PATH setup lives in ~/.zshrc, so `node` resolves in an interactive shell and nowhere else — sessions launched by launchd, a GUI app, or cron died with a bare ENOENT and no workspace tools. /bin/sh is the one interpreter always present. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is Claude Code's substitution for the install path, so nothing here is CWD-dependent. The bundle is regenerated by `bun run build:mcp` (which writes here and to packages/mcp/dist/mcp.js). Port is auto-discovered from ~/.claude/live-feedback/server.json — that path is deliberately NOT renamed with the plugin: serve.ts writes it and the MCP child reads it at start, so moving it needs a dual-write transition rather than a rename.
